title: Common
description: Building blocks shared by the Electriplan contracts. Lengths are millimetres unless a property name says otherwise (lengthM is metres, demandA amperes...).

id.title: Id
id.description: An identifier, unique within its document: wall_004, lt_001, c_L1.

millimetres.title: Millimetres
millimetres.description: A length or distance in millimetres, never negative.

point.title: Point
point.description: A position in plan coordinates, millimetres. Origin at the top-left of the drawing area, y downwards (SVG convention); may be negative.

side.title: Side
side.description: Which face of a wall, looking from the wall's start towards its end.

wallAnchor.title: WallAnchor
wallAnchor.description: A position on a wall face, so it moves with the wall: the wall, the distance from the wall's start, the face, and the height above the finished floor.

source.title: Source
source.description: Who placed an item: the engine, or a person (who the engine then designs around and never moves).
